1.consolidated_definition: Reunión de poca gente que ocurre después de una fiesta, un concierto o la visita a una discoteca. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Durante el after party auspiciado por Finlandia los productores despidieron a Marian Guillén, Super Model of the World Puerto Rico 2005, quien se mudará a Nueva York para trabajar con la agencia Ford Models (DesireeLowry.com, 16-01-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Gathering of a small group of people that occurs after a party, concert, or nightclub visit. Raw anglicism, infrequently used. During the Finland-sponsored after-party, producers fired Marian Guillén, Super Model of the World Puerto Rico 2005, who will move to New York to work with Ford Models agency (DesireeLowry.com, 16-01-07)
